paragraphs.text:
“The cult is very old, with origins attributed to Akhenaten 
himself. Cult practices led to perversions and oddities partially 
prompting the Pharaoh’s downfall. I suggest placing extra guards 
at key locations, and ignoring their so-called holy place at Tell-
el-Amarna, an unimportant tomb. The murder cases will remain 
open, though I doubt we’ll find the culprit who left behind such 
a strange calling card.” 
Return to 275.
